title: Left-handed banjo players
summary: Talk of a left-handed stepbrother and Narvin Kimball's left-handed banjo playing at Preservation Hall.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, he had a thing that go on one time. But I don't know, he got the devil in him, you know, try to buy a house. That got away from him. He tried to play piano but I told him, you know, I said I never seen a left hand piano play yet, man. I've never seen a left hand piano play, man. I've seen a right hand piano play, you know. I never seen a... Kim was on a left hand banjo play, I've seen.

Well, Sylvester Handy is based... He's left handed but he... The way he plays it, he puts his right hand around backwards somehow or other. You notice? He plays left handed because he's left handed but it's the way he holds the strings by twisting his hand around.
Kim was left handed too but he writes right handed.
He writes right handed, that's right. He writes right handed, that's right. Come to think of it, when he signed my book, I remember...
But he does everything else left handed.

But, I know, I remember one night at Preservation Hall though, some guy came up, a white man, and he said to Kimble, You know, that's the first left handed banjo I've seen in a long time and I play banjo left handed. He said, I wonder if you'd let me play your banjo for one number. So, I don't know who Kimble was playing with that night. So the guy said, he said, okay. So they let the man sit down, he was great, he wasn't house though. But, and then he thanked Kimble and he said, you're the only other left handed banjo player I ever saw in my life.
I was from New York, I don't remember. You remember that night?
Yeah, New York. He came from the performance hall. We met him in New York.
And, well I'm left handed so it kind of interests me. I had three lessons on the violin one time but the neighbors bought me a pair of skates. I guess they didn't want to hear me practice.
